title: Avimi, one of the companions
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He visited the sick in the time of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, as stated in Bereshit Rabbah 13:16, where Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba spoke to him.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “One of the companions” follows the literal מן חבריא designation; no modern place or authority identity is inferred. Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba is the speaker addressing Avimi in the consulted 13:16 paragraph.

The whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah 13:16 paragraph names Avimi min chavraya visiting the sick, and fully writes Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba asking him how they are doing. This supports the local full title, the contextual acronym expansion and the direction of address. Hyman’s time statement and companion designation remain; no link to another Avimi or new teacher relationship is admitted.
